rows.label: Corporation tax [national]
rows.value: 12.5% on trading income; 25% on non-trading income and excepted trades; 15% minimum effective rate (domestic top-up tax) for groups and standalone entities with revenue over €750,000,000. Paid by companies resident in Ireland, and non-resident companies trading through an Irish branch or agency. Taxes Consolidation Act 1997; Part 4A for the top-up taxes.

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: branch profits: corporation tax at the same rates; distributions: 25% Dividend Withholding Tax; close companies: 20% surcharge on undistributed investment and estate income (15% on half of professional and service income). Paid by companies (DWT is withheld from the shareholder's dividend). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 Part 6 Chapter 8A (DWT), sections 440 and 441 (surcharges).

rows.value: 4.2% to 30 September 2026, 4.35% from 1 October 2026 (4.2375% for 2026 income in self-assessment), minimum €650. Paid by self-employed people with income of €5,000 or more. Social Welfare Consolidation Act 2005, Part 2 Chapter 3. In force from 1 January 2026.

rows.value: income tax at the normal rates, collected through PAYE, on pay for duties performed in Ireland; tax credits in full or in part only for EU citizens and treaty-country citizens. rows.label: Capital Gains Tax [national]
rows.value: 31% on most gains disposed of from 7 October 2026 (33% before); 33% on development land; 40% on foreign life policies and investment products; annual personal exemption €1,270. Paid by individuals, trusts, and companies on development land gains. Taxes Consolidation Act 1997, Parts 19 to 21.

rows.source_title: Revenue: Dividend Withholding Tax (DWT) (published 24 August 2026)
rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and royalties: DWT, DIRT and interest withholding [national]
rows.value: Dividend Withholding Tax 25%; DIRT 33% on deposit interest; withholding at the standard rate (20%) on annual interest and patent royalties, with exemptions for many non-resident recipients. Paid by shareholders, depositors and recipients (withheld by the payer). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 Part 6 Chapter 8A (DWT), Part 8 Chapter 4 (DIRT), sections 238 and 246.

rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: Net rental income taxed at the income tax rates with USC and PRSI; Rent-a-Room Relief up to €14,000; tenants of non-resident landlords withhold 20%; pensions taxed through PAYE, retirement lump sums tax-free up to €200,000 (20% to €500,000, 40% above). Paid by landlords and pensioners. Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 (Case V; section 216A rent-a-room; Part 30 pensions).

rows.label: Auto-enrolment: MyFutureFund (occupational pension) [national]
rows.value: 1.5% employee, 1.5% employer and 0.5% State of gross pay in 2026 to 2028, rising to 6%, 6% and 2% from 2035; pay over €80,000 ignored; employees aged 23 to 60 earning €20,000 or more without a workplace pension. Paid by employees and employers, with a State top-up. Automatic Enrolment Retirement Savings System Act 2024.

rows.label: Excise duties: alcohol, tobacco, mineral oil and sugar-sweetened drinks [national]
rows.value: Spirits €42.57 per litre of alcohol; cigarettes €520.88 per 1,000 plus 8.67% of retail price (minimum €570.73 per 1,000) from 7 October 2026; petrol €502.88 and diesel €371.85 per 1,000 litres including carbon tax from 14 October 2026; sugar-sweetened drinks €16.26 or €24.39 per hectolitre. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Finance Act 2003 (alcohol products tax), Finance Act 2005 (tobacco products tax), Finance Act 1999 (mineral oil tax), Finance Act 2018 (sugar sweetened drinks tax).

rows.value: 3% of gross non-life premiums; 1% of life assurance premiums; €1 stamp duty per non-life policy; levy on health insurers from €34 to €172 a year per insured person. Paid by insurers (passed on in premiums). Stamp Duties Consolidation Act 1999 sections 124B, 125 and 125A.

rows.value: 1% of the consideration or market value on transfers of shares and marketable securities; 7.5% where the shares derive their value from Irish immovable property; no duty on new issues. Paid by buyers. Stamp Duties Consolidation Act 1999, Schedule 1.

rows.source_title: Revenue: Excises on natural gas, solid fuel and electricity (published 2 November 2026)
rows.label: Electricity Tax (energy tax) [national]
rows.value: €1.00 per megawatt hour for business and non-business use. Paid by suppliers of electricity (passed on to users). Finance Act 2008 Part 2 Chapter 3.

rows.source_title: Revenue: Mineral Oil Tax rates (published 2 November 2026)
rows.label: Carbon tax on fuels (mineral oil, natural gas and solid fuel carbon taxes) [national]
rows.value: €71.00 per tonne of CO2 on petrol, diesel and natural gas from 14 October 2026 (€63.50 or €48.50 on some heating fuels); natural gas €8.77 per MWh; coal €167.24 per tonne. Paid by fuel suppliers (passed on in prices). Finance Act 1999 Part 2 Chapter 1 (mineral oil tax); Finance Act 2010 Part 2 (natural gas and solid fuel carbon taxes).

rows.source_title: Revenue: CAT group thresholds
rows.label: Capital Acquisitions Tax (gift tax and inheritance tax) [national]
rows.value: 33% above lifetime group thresholds: Group A €420,000 (children), Group B €44,000 (parents, siblings, nieces, nephews, grandchildren), Group C €22,000 (others) from 7 October 2026; spouses and civil partners exempt; €3,000 small gift exemption a year per donor. Paid by the beneficiary (recipient of the gift or inheritance). Capital Acquisitions Tax Consolidation Act 2003.

rows.source_title: Revenue: Calculating VRT: Applying the tax
rows.label: Vehicle Registration Tax and motor tax (vehicle tax) [national]
rows.value: VRT on cars: 7% (minimum €140) to 41% (minimum €820) of the open market selling price by CO2 emissions, plus a NOx levy; annual motor tax by CO2 band, €120 a year for a zero-emission car registered from 2021. Paid by vehicle owners (VRT on first registration in the State). Finance Act 1992 Part II Chapter IV (VRT); Finance (Excise Duties) (Vehicles) Act 1952 (motor tax).

rows.source_title: Revenue: Removal of the De Minimis Relief for Low Value Consignments – 1 July 2026 (published 11 June 2026)
rows.label: Customs duty, import VAT and traveller allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: €3 customs duty per distinct item on e-commerce packages of €150 or less from outside the EU since 1 July 2026, plus a €2 Union Handling Fee per item from 1 November 2026; above €150, duty at the tariff rate on price plus transport and insurance; import VAT unless paid through IOSS; traveller allowance €430; cash of €10,000 or more must be declared. Paid by importers and travellers. Union Customs Code (Regulation (EU) No 952/2013) and the EU customs reform; Value-Added Tax Consolidation Act 2010.

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: financial cards and insurance policies [national]
rows.value: €30 a year per credit or charge card account; €0.12 per ATM withdrawal up to €2.50 a year per card (€5.00 for combined cards); €1 per non-life insurance policy. Paid by cardholders and policyholders (collected by the card issuer or insurer). Stamp Duties Consolidation Act 1999 sections 123, 123B and Schedule 1.

rows.value: €160 a year for homes and businesses with a television; free for people who qualify for Household Benefits. Paid by households and businesses with a television. Broadcasting Act 2009 Part 9.

rows.label: Special Assignee Relief Programme (SARP): inbound expat regime [national]
rows.value: 30% of employment income above €125,000 (arrivals from 2026; €100,000 for earlier arrivals) disregarded from income tax, up to €1,000,000 of income, for up to 5 years; not from USC; minimum basic salary €125,000. Paid by employees assigned to Ireland by a foreign employer (arrivals 2012 to 2030). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 section 825C.
